description: Colorado-specific land access classification rules. These override national defaults where Colorado has more specific data or different rules. Sources: Colorado Parks and Wildlife (CPW), Colorado State Land Board (CSLB), WGFD. Rules receive a +1000 priority boost over national rules.

rules.source_dataset: Colorado Parks & Wildlife — State Wildlife Areas
rules.note: Colorado State Wildlife Areas (SWAs) are managed by CPW primarily for hunting and fishing. Hunting is generally open to licensed hunters. Verify current SWA-specific regulations, as some have seasonal restrictions, special-permit requirements, or portions closed for wildlife management.

rules.source_dataset: Colorado Parks & Wildlife — Walk-In Access / Public Access Program
rules.note: This property is enrolled in CPW's Walk-In Access or Public Access Program, making it open to hunting during the designated season. Access is seasonal — verify current enrollment dates with CPW. Program participation changes annually.

rules.source_dataset: Colorado State Land Board / Colorado Parks & Wildlife — Public Access Lease
rules.note: This State Trust Land parcel is under a CPW public-access lease, opening it to hunting and fishing. State Trust Land is Category 3 by default — upgrade to Category 1 only where this lease is confirmed in CPW's access dataset.

rules.source_dataset: Colorado State Land Board — State Trust Land
rules.note: Colorado State Trust Land is managed for revenue generation (grazing, mineral leases, timber). It is closed to public access by default — Category 3. It is upgraded to Category 1 only where CPW holds a confirmed public-access lease (see co_cpw_lease rule). Do not assume state trust land is open.

rules.source_dataset: Colorado Parks & Wildlife — Game Management Units
rules.note: This polygon represents a Game Management Unit (GMU) boundary. GMU boundaries define where specific licenses are valid, but they are not land ownership or access boundaries. Access depends on the underlying land ownership — GMU membership alone does not grant hunting access.
